Amazon Fresh 
In early 2022, our Amazon Fresh location 
in Seattle, Washington, became the world’s 
first grocery store to pursue Zero Carbon 
Certification 
 from the International Living 
Future Institute, a leading nonprofit dedicated 
to advancing sustainable building practices. 
More than a dozen upgrades were incorporated 
throughout the development of the store, 
including transitioning to a carbon dioxide 
(CO2)-based refrigeration system. As a result of 
these upgrades, we expect the store will save 
nearly 185 tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e) each 
year—the equivalent of driving around the 
Earth 18 times in a standard passenger vehicle.1
